title: ISC — KPI Breach Alert
description: Triggers when ISC fires a kpi.threshold_breach webhook. Routes warn severity to Slack and critical severity to Gmail + SMS via Zapier Webhooks.

settings.note: Copy the generated Catch Hook URL and paste it into ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'kpi.threshold_breach'.

steps.name: Only continue if severity is warn
steps.note: This path handles warn-level breaches only. Duplicate the Zap and change this filter to 'critical' for the critical path.

data.text: ⚠️ *KPI Warning* — `{{1__data__kpiLabel}}` is at {{1__data__value}} (warn threshold: {{1__data__warnThreshold}}). Review in ISC: https://YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN/

settings.note: Replace with your Slack Incoming Webhook URL.
Use the same Catch Hook URL as the warn Zap — ISC sends all breaches to one webhook; Zapier filters by severity.

critical_path_steps.name: Only continue if severity is critical

settings.subject: 🚨 CRITICAL KPI Breach — {{1__data__kpiLabel}}
settings.body:
🚨 Critical KPI Breach

KPI: {{1__data__kpiLabel}}
Current Value: {{1__data__value}}
Critical Threshold: {{1__data__criticalThreshold}}

→ View in ISC Platform
settings.note: Connect your Gmail account and replace the recipient email and YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN.

settings.body: 🚨 CRITICAL KPI Breach: {{1__data__kpiLabel}} = {{1__data__value}}. Log in to ISC immediately: https://YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN/
settings.note: Alternatively, replace this step with the Twilio or Vonage app for production SMS delivery.

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap and choose 'Webhooks by Zapier' as the trigger with event 'Catch Hook'.
2. Copy the Catch Hook URL and register it in ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'kpi.threshold_breach'.
3. Add a Filter step: continue only if severity (Text) Exactly matches 'warn'.
4. Add a Webhooks POST action and paste your Slack Incoming Webhook URL. Use the payload in this file.
5. Create a second Zap using the same webhook URL, filter for 'critical', and add Gmail + SMS actions.
6. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN, recipient email, and phone number.
